name: Draggable Vase Grid
description: Full-screen draggable grid of product tiles that zooms in on load. Clicking a tile flips it into a side panel with split-text reveals of its title, price and description.
contents: Staggered grid of product image tiles
Side detail panel with product thumbnail, title, price and description
Round close cross that follows the cursor while the panel is open
behavior: Tiles pop in with a random stagger, then the grid scales up to full size
Grid is dragged with inertia and also pans with the mouse wheel or trackpad
Tiles outside the viewport fade and shrink, and return when visible
Clicking a tile slides the panel in, flips the tile into it and reveals the text line by line and char by char
Clicking another tile swaps the product, clicking the background, the cross or the open tile closes the panel
editableByProps: Products with image, title, price and description
Grid size, tile size and gap
Background, panel and close icon colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pairing of products to grid cells
Change panel text sizes and colors
Change the tile flip duration or easing

fixed: Listens to window wheel events and prevents default, so the grid pans instead of the page scrolling
Listens to window mousemove and resize, removed on unmount
Root fills the viewport height with hidden overflow and the grid and panel are fixed to the viewport, so it should be the only content on the screen
Uses gsap Draggable, Flip, SplitText and InertiaPlugin
Panel text sizes are viewport-based and the panel widens to 90% below 600px
